story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. In plain words: Empirical relationships describing how model performance improves predictably as a function of model size, dataset size, and compute used for training. Here is how it actually plays out: Scaling laws have guided decisions about how to allocate compute budgets between larger models versus more training data, and were pivotal in motivating the trend toward ever-larger language models. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Scaling Laws.

citation.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
